command:
set -e
cd /etc/postgresql-tls
gen_server() {
  name=$1; ip=$2
  sudo openssl genrsa -out $name/server.key 2048
  sudo chmod 600 $name/server.key
  sudo openssl req -new -key $name/server.key -subj "/CN=$name" -out $name/server.csr
  sudo sh -c "cat > $name/san.cnf" <<EOF
subjectAltName=DNS:$name,IP:$ip
EOF
  sudo openssl x509 -req -in $name/server.csr -CA ca/ca.crt -CAkey ca/ca.key -CAcreateserial \
    -out $name/server.crt -days 825 -sha256 -extfile $name/san.cnf
  sudo cp ca/ca.crt $name/ca.crt
}
gen_server node1 10.100.40.10
gen_server node2 10.100.40.11
gen_server node3 10.100.40.12

# client cert for replication user
sudo openssl genrsa -out client-replicator/client.key 2048
sudo chmod 600 client-replicator/client.key
sudo openssl req -new -key client-replicator/client.key -subj "/CN=replicator" -out client-replicator/client.csr
sudo openssl x509 -req -in client-replicator/client.csr -CA ca/ca.crt -CAkey ca/ca.key -CAcreateserial \
  -out client-replicator/client.crt -days 825 -sha256
sudo cp ca/ca.crt client-replicator/ca.crt
echo DONE
ls -la node1 node2 node3 client-replicator
